payload.title: Forum freshness: Message stream re-renders thread pages and index, uncached thread JSON, purge when posting is on
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Phase 6 of PPY-452419: a new post reaches the static thread page and the forum index by itself, and the per-thread JSON the island reads is never stale at the edge.

## Today
#906: the `home-page` plugin streams the Reference table and (with `homePage.threads.enabled`) the Message table into `homePageTrigger`, which claims a debounce slot and schedules `home-page-snapshot`; `task.py` rewrites `threads.json` and `threads/<key>.json` and calls `project_listings` so pages whose digest changed are re-rendered; `freshness.purge` (default false) invalidates changed files on CloudFront.

## Change
1. `homePageTrigger` (`amplify/plugins/home-page/function/`) already opens the window on Message `status`, `content`, `editedAt`, `deletedAt` changes (docs ~80); add `authorKind` and `authorLabel` (a handle change must re-render) and new thread creation (MessageThread stream, if not already consumed; read `papyrus.plugin.ts`).
2. Thread pages and forum index pages are part of the re-render set: their digest folds in the thread file digest (thread-pages task), so `project_listings` already rewrites them; assert it with a fixture (change one Message -> exactly that thread page, the index page(s) containing it, and the authored pages with a `threads` include are rewritten; nothing else).
3. Purge for the forum: `homePage.forum.purge` (default **true** when `posting.enabled`, because a poster expects others to see the post; false otherwise) invalidates `/<threadBase>/<key>/*`, `/<threadBase>/*` and `/_data/home-page/threads/<key>.json` after a write; share the invalidation code with `freshness.purge`. Cost note in docs: CloudFront invalidations are free up to 1000 paths a month, then per path; a busy forum should set the thread JSON's `Cache-Control` to `no-store` instead (the writer already sets `PAPYRUS_HTML_S_MAXAGE_SECONDS` for HTML; add `PAPYRUS_DATA_S_MAXAGE_SECONDS` for `_data/home-page/threads/*.json`, default 0 when posting is on).
4. Debounce window for posting sites: keep `debounceSeconds` (default 300) but document that the island shows the author's own post immediately, so the window is about other readers; no new default.

## Gherkin (`features_backend/home-page-freshness.feature`, extend)
  Scenario: A new reader post re-renders its thread page, the forum index and nothing else
  Scenario: A handle change re-renders the pages that show that author
  Scenario: With posting enabled the thread JSON is served uncached and the thread page is purged after a write
  Scenario: A site without the forum keeps today's freshness behaviour byte-identically

## Acceptance
- Unit tests for the trigger's change filter; fixture assertion on the rewritten set; `docs/home-page.md` "Freshness" gains the forum paragraph. No AWS writes.
- Blocked by the thread-pages and forum-index tasks.
